headline: Tesla and SpaceX Shares Decline Following US Midterm Election Outcomes
summary: Shares of Tesla and SpaceX declined as investors express concern regarding potential policy shifts under new Democratic officials following the U.S. elections.
why: Tesla is a major electric vehicle manufacturer and SpaceX is a prominent private aerospace company, both led by billionaire Elon Musk. Regulatory policies and government contracts under changing political administrations can significantly impact their operational landscapes.

impacts.name: Tesla
impacts.why: Shares slid due to investor concerns over less favorable policies under new officials.
impacts.baseline_rule: first recorded price at or after created_at (15-minute price recorder); end = first price at least 24 h later, within 48 h

why_moved: Shares slid as investors grew worried about potentially less favorable policies under new Democratic officials following the U.S. election.
